summary: Iteration 4 — Frontend E2E testing of new 3-area architecture (Nutricionista, Consultório, Paciente). All 16 review-request flows verified PASS via Playwright. Real Claude AI calls (consult-chat + patient-chat) returned valid responses within 30-45s. Protected role-based routing works correctly (patient hitting /agentes or /dashboard is redirected to /paciente). Patient signup form pre-fills email read-only and creates role='patient' session cookie. Pre-consultation public chat regression OK (welcome message renders).

issues: Após clicar em patient-logout, o usuário é redirecionado para /login em vez da landing page (/). O review_request pede 'redirect para landing /'. Comportamento atual cai em /login porque o componente protegido vê user=null e a rota raiz não está sendo alvo do logout. Verificar lógica em PatientArea.jsx / AuthContext.logout().

action_items: MINOR: Patient logout should redirect to landing '/' instead of '/login' per review_request. AuthContext.logout() likely calls navigate('/login'); change to navigate('/') for patient role.
critical_code_review_comments: Sucesso.jsx: redirect post-signup uses setTimeout(800ms) before navigate('/paciente') — acceptable but the cookie is set by patientSignup before the timeout; works in tests but a slow network could land the user on /paciente before user state hydrates (loader). Consider awaiting user state in AuthContext before navigating.

Protected component: when role mismatch, redirects to /paciente or /dashboard based on user.role, which is correct. But the patient is redirected silently — consider showing a toast 'Acesso restrito' for UX.

PatientArea diet placeholder text is short ('Ainda não há plano prescrito') — good. But there is no skeleton/loading state shown while fetching the diet; consider a spinner since /api/patient/me/diet is async.

Consultorio.jsx: 10 test patients (TEST_*) shown without filter — patient-list could grow large in production. The buscar-paciente input is visible but its behaviour was not tested; verify it actually filters the list client-side.

Agentes.jsx delete uses native window.confirm — would be nicer to use a shadcn AlertDialog with data-testid for cancel/confirm so it is testable without dialog handlers. Currently it works (handled with page.once('dialog', ...)).

success_rate.frontend: 94% (15/16 PASS, 1 PARTIAL on logout landing target)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Use admin@rogeriocosta.com.br/rogerio2025. To test patient flows, create a fresh lead with email via POST /api/leads then go to /sucesso/{token} and submit the signup form. Note: /api/auth/me returns role correctly; cross-origin httpOnly SameSite=none cookie is preserved by Playwright. Real Claude calls take 5-15s — use timeout=45000 on wait_for_selector for *-msg-assistant testids. Don't try urllib inside playwright sandbox (403 outbound) — use curl in bash to create leads, then pass token to script.
rca of the issue: The single PARTIAL result (patient logout landing at /login instead of /) is most likely because AuthContext.logout() unconditionally navigates to '/login' regardless of role. To verify open AuthContext.jsx and check the logout() handler. Mitigation: navigate('/') for role==='patient', or just navigate('/') in all cases (login page is accessible from landing anyway).
